text.p: Following are the main stories in Monday's Malaysian newspapers. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
-- Foreign Minister Abdullah Ahmad Badawi today maintained that ASEAN will admit Myanmar despite strong protest by the United States.
-- The Health Ministry has advised kidney patients against going abroad to less developed countries such as India and China for kidney transplants.
-- Malaysia, brushing off the United States' opposition to Myanmar joining ASEAN, said the grouping has a much better understanding of the situation in that country.

- National carrier Malaysia Airlines is not concerned about competition from North American carriers that will follow the signing of an "open skies" aviation agreement to end restrictions on flights between Malaysia and the U.S.
